title: Quot over B x P^n_Z with the pulled-back O(1) is proper
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file moduli.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Prove Quot^P_{F/X/B} is proper for X = B x P^n_Z with L the pullback of O(1): properness is etale local so take B affine; L is ample on X, so choose a surjection O_X^{oplus r} -> F tensor L^{tensor r'} (characterize-ample); twist invariance (lemma-quot-tensor-invertible) replaces F by F tensor L^{tensor r'} and P by P(t + r'); the quotient lemma (lemma-quot-quotient) gives a closed immersion Quot^P_F -> Quot^P_{O^{oplus r}}, and the target is proper over B by lemma-quot-Pn.
